$comment: Generated from packages/protocol/src/schema by scripts/emit-schema.ts. Do not edit by hand; run `pnpm --filter @gitglasses/protocol build`.

initialize.description: Handshake. The engine rejects a protocolVersion it does not implement, so this must be the first request of a session.

shutdown.description: Asks the engine to stop accepting work and exit.

repo/discover.description: Registers the repository containing `path`, walking up like `git rev-parse --git-dir`, and starts watching it. The returned repoId addresses it for the rest of the session.

repo/close.description: Releases everything held for a repository: its watch, its cached graph plans and its registry entry. Later requests for the id fail with RepoNotFound.

repo/state.description: Where HEAD points and what multi-step operation, if any, the repository is stopped in the middle of.

sequencer.description: What the repository is in the middle of. Complements `head`: a repository stopped mid-rebase reports a detached HEAD, and only this tells a client why.

operation.description: Multi-step operation the repository is stopped in the middle of, read from the sequencer state in the gitdir.

blame/file.description: Blames a file at a revision (working tree by default, honouring unsaved contents pushed via doc/didChange). Hunks stream as blame/hunks notifications tagged with `streamId`; the result carries only the totals and the commit table.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root.

rev.description: Revision to blame. Omitted blames the working tree.

streamId.description: Correlates the blame/hunks notifications of this request.

log/commits.description: Topo-ordered commit page from a ref (default HEAD).

ref.description: Revision to walk from. Omitted means HEAD.

limit.description: Maximum entries in the page. Omitted means 100.

history/file.description: File history following renames, newest first.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root.

limit.description: Maximum entries in the page. Omitted means 100.

history/line.description: History of a line range (1-based, inclusive).

path.description: Path relative to the repository root.

search/commits.description: Commit search over HEAD history. Matches stream as search/matches notifications tagged with `streamId`; the result carries only the totals.

streamId.description: Correlates the search/matches notifications of this request.

limit.description: Maximum entries in the page. Omitted means 100.

query.description: Criteria, ANDed together. An absent or empty query matches every commit, so the page is bounded only by `limit`.

rev/fileAtRev.description: Contents of a file at a revision, passed through the repository's checkout filters so it compares byte-for-byte against an editor buffer. Binary blobs are reported, not returned.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root.

rev.description: Revision the file is read from.

maxBytes.description: Cap on the returned contents. Omitted means 4194304.

refs/list.description: Refs listing for views: branches, remotes, tags.

status/summary.description: Working tree and index summary, plus upstream divergence.

graph/rows.description: Graph rows with engine-computed lane layout, topo order, paged.

limit.description: Maximum entries in the page. Omitted means 100.

include.description: Synthetic rows to mix in among the commits. Absent members default to false.

refsFingerprint.description: Content hash of the ref set the page was sliced from. Constant across the pages of one snapshot and different once any ref moves; unrelated to the monotonic counter in repo/didChange.

diff/commit.description: Files changed by one commit, against its first parent's tree.

diff/refs.description: Files changed between two revisions' trees.

diff/fileHunks.description: Hunks of a file's working-tree (or staged) diff, for hunk staging.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root.

staged.description: Diff the index against HEAD instead of the working tree against the index.

stage/hunks.description: Stages or unstages individual hunks. The ranges are matched against a freshly taken diff, so a request built from a stale diff/fileHunks page fails instead of applying the wrong lines.

path.description: Path relative to the repository root.

hunks.description: Hunk ranges exactly as diff/fileHunks reported them.

mutate/branchCreate.description: Creates a branch, optionally checking it out.

startPoint.description: Revision to branch from. Omitted means HEAD.

mutate/switch.description: Checks out a ref, detaching HEAD when it is not a local branch.

mutate/merge.description: Merges a ref into HEAD. Conflicts are a result, not an error.

mutate/cherryPick.description: Cherry-picks commits onto HEAD. Conflicts are a result, not an error.

mutate/revert.description: Reverts commits on HEAD. Conflicts are a result, not an error.

mutate/reset.description: Moves HEAD to a revision, optionally rewriting index and working tree.

remote.description: Remote to fetch. Omitted uses git's default.

mutate/pull.description: Pulls into the current branch using git's configured strategy.

message.description: Stash message. Omitted uses git's generated one.

stash/apply.description: Applies a stash entry. Conflicts are a result, not an error; git keeps the entry on conflict even for a pop.

pop.description: Drops the entry after a clean apply. Required: the two behaviours are not interchangeable, so the engine will not guess.

worktree/add.description: Adds a worktree checked out at a revision.

path.description: Directory to create the worktree in.

createBranch.description: Branch to create at `ref` for the new worktree.

rebase/preview.description: Commits upstream..HEAD, oldest first — the editable rebase plan.

rebase/start.description: Executes an interactive rebase with the given plan via sequence-editor interception. Conflicts pause the rebase; repo/state then reports the sequencer step.

plan.description: Steps in execution order. An empty plan rebases nothing.

rebase/continue.description: Resumes a paused rebase once the conflicts are staged.

patch/create.description: Creates a shareable patch envelope from WIP, a stash, a commit, or a range.

summary.description: Overrides the summary derived from the source.

patch/apply.description: Applies a patch envelope; 3-way when the base is missing.

doc/didChange.description: Pushes an editor buffer into the engine so working-tree blame reflects unsaved edits.

doc/didClose.description: Drops a pushed buffer; blame reverts to the file on disk.

$/cancelRequest.description: Asks the engine to abandon an in-flight request.

blame/hunks.description: A batch of blame hunks for the blame/file request carrying this streamId.

search/matches.description: A batch of matches for the search/commits request carrying this streamId.

repo/didChange.description: Pushed when the repository's git state changes on disk. Categories are debounced and coalesced, so one notification can carry several.

generation.description: Per-repo counter, incremented once per pushed notification. Unrelated to the ref-set hash in graph/rows.
